whatIsDefilicious.question: What is Defilicious?
whatIsDefilicious.answer: Defilicious helps you discover restaurants, explore menus, find special offers, and access useful dining features in one place.

accountRequirements.question: Do I need an account to use Defilicious?
accountRequirements.answer: You can browse restaurants, menus, and available offers without an account. Some features, including student verification, order tracking, and personalized account tools, may require you to sign in.

findRestaurant.question: How can I find a restaurant?
findRestaurant.answer: Open the Restaurants section and browse the available places. Use the existing search and filtering options to narrow the results by cuisine, location, rating, or available offer.

viewMenus.question: Where can I view restaurant menus?
viewMenus.answer: Menus are available in the Menu section and on individual restaurant pages. Dish names, prices, descriptions, and availability are based on the information provided by each restaurant.

specialOffers.question: How do special offers work?
specialOffers.answer: Special offers are provided by participating restaurants and may have specific conditions, availability periods, or usage restrictions. Review the offer details before using it.

delivery.question: How does delivery work?
delivery.answer: Available delivery options depend on the restaurant and your location. Delivery time and availability are displayed before you complete an order when that information is available.

trackOrder.question: How can I track my order?
trackOrder.answer: Open the Orders section in your account and select the required order. If tracking is available, the current status and relevant updates will be displayed.

studentDiscounts.question: How do student discounts work?
studentDiscounts.answer: Verified students can access eligible student offers through Defilicious. Available discounts and their conditions may vary depending on the restaurant.

incorrectInformation.question: What should I do if restaurant or offer information is incorrect?
incorrectInformation.answer: Check whether the offer is still active and review its conditions. If the information still appears incorrect, contact Defilicious Support and include the restaurant name, the affected offer, and a short description of the issue.

contactSupport.question: How can I contact Defilicious Support?
contactSupport.answer: Open Help & Support and describe what happened. Select the most relevant issue category and provide enough information for the support team to understand the problem.

hero.label: About service
hero.aside: Defilicious helps customers order food quickly, while restaurants manage delivery, menus, and orders in one place.
hero.title: About Defilicious
hero.lead: Defilicious is a digital food ordering service that connects customers, restaurants, and delivery in one clear system.
hero.description: We are building more than a restaurant catalog. Defilicious makes ordering faster, more transparent, and more convenient: from choosing a dish to payment and real-time delivery tracking.
hero.clientsText: Fast dish selection, convenient payment, repeat favorite orders, and real-time delivery control.
hero.restaurantsText: Menu, stop-list, order, kitchen process, and sales analytics management.

mission.label: OUR MISSION
mission.title: Our goal is to remove chaos from food ordering.
mission.firstText: Defilicious was created to make delivery clear for every participant: the customer sees what is happening with the order, the restaurant quickly manages the menu and kitchen, and the system helps avoid unnecessary mistakes.
mission.secondText: We want users to avoid wasting time on long choices, stop worrying about delivery status, and order food in the most convenient way. For businesses, this means less chaos in operations, faster menu updates, and transparent performance analytics.

audience.label: Audience
audience.title: Who Defilicious is made for
audience.intro: Defilicious is created for two key audiences: people who want to order food quickly and without stress, and restaurants that need a convenient tool for managing orders, menus, and kitchen processes.

denis.name: Denis Korzhyk
denis.summary: Responsible for product logic, user experience, interface structure, and the visual system of Defilicious.
details: Has 6 years of design experience and works at the intersection of UX/UI, business analysis, and product strategy. Specializes in creating clear user flows, optimizing funnels, automating processes, and improving business metrics through design.

bohdan.name: Bohdan Shevchenko
bohdan.summary: Responsible for technical implementation, project architecture, and stability of the core service features.
details: Has 4 years of experience creating websites and web applications, worked with commercial products and large companies. Understands the full development cycle: from application structure to feature implementation, code optimization, and preparing the product for scaling.

artem.name: Artem Hrebeniuk
artem.summary: Responsible for functional modules, application logic integration, and stable work of separate system parts.
details: Has experience with different types of projects, from dynamic web services to systems connected with transactions, analytics, and high reliability requirements. Understands the importance of security, data accuracy, and stable interaction between product components.

mykola.name: Mykola Hitis
mykola.summary: Responsible for engineering quality, testing, security, bug detection, and application stability.
details: Focuses on checking the system in real and complex scenarios: incorrect user actions, data errors, authorization issues, access problems, or potential security risks.

stack.label: Stack
stack.title: Technology stack
stack.description: To build Defilicious, we use a modern JavaScript stack that helps us develop the interface quickly, build server logic, work with the database, and support project scalability.

methodology.label: Methodology
methodology.buildTextFirst: Defilicious is developed incrementally. We build the product step by step: implement separate parts of the functionality, test them early, improve them, and then move on to the next stage.
methodology.buildTextSecond: This approach helps us see results faster, reduce risks, and maintain quality while the product grows.
methodology.worksTextFirst: The incremental model allows the team to work with more control and clarity. Instead of building everything at once, we focus on smaller parts, validate decisions early, and improve the product continuously.
methodology.worksTextSecond: This makes development more flexible, helps us react faster to issues, and keeps the product stable as it evolves.

partnership.processTitle: From your first hello to your first order.
partnership.processDescription: A practical plan for getting your restaurant ready. We work through the details together before launch.
steps: Share your restaurant name, city and a contact number. Add your website or a question if there’s something you’d like us to look at first.
We review your location and talk through collection, delivery and commercial terms. You get a clear picture of how Defilicious would work for your kitchen.
Once the terms are agreed, we plan your menu, restaurant page and order handover together. Your team knows what to prepare; ours knows where to collect.

partnership.faqDescription: Delivery, terms and getting started. The things you need to know before getting in touch.
faq: Do we need our own delivery team?
No. Defilicious organises collection and delivery for orders placed through the service. Your restaurant prepares the food for collection.
What are the fees and partnership terms?
We discuss commercial terms individually after reviewing your inquiry, before onboarding begins.
Which cities can we join in?
Include your city in the inquiry. Our team will confirm whether partnership and delivery are available for your location; submitting the form does not confirm coverage.
What do we need for the first inquiry?
Your restaurant name, city, contact person and phone number. A website, email and comment are optional. There is no need to prepare a menu or upload documents.
Does an inquiry mean we have signed up?
No. It is a request to discuss a partnership. Onboarding only follows once the details and terms have been agreed.
